name: jsonaggregator
description: Data Hunt — dogs hunt data: Kennels, Waves, Serialized TypeScript in the void. Express, Angular, Prisma.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:packages && cd ui-app && npm install --prefer-offline
scripts.build:dogs: npm run build:dogs-demo && npm run build:dogs-geo && npm run build:dogs-warframe && npm run build:dogs-hue && npm run build:dogs-talking && npm run build:dogs-db
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:dogs
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.dev: npm run prisma:sync && concurrently -n backend,ui -c blue,green "ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register main.ts" "npm run ui"
scripts.ui: cd ui-app && npx ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.json --open
scripts.typecheck:dogs: cd packages/dogs-demo && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-geo && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-warframe && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-hue && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-talking && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dogs-db && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:dogs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json

author: Martin
